enrichments.summary: YoCrunch Lowfat Yogurt with Toppers, including Strawberry Yogurt with milk chocolate M&Ms pieces and Strawberry Yogurt with Oreo pieces, is being recalled due to the presence of foreign material, specifically plastic pieces.
YoCrunch Lowfat Yogurt with Snickers and Twix bar pieces is being recalled due to the presence of foreign material (plastic pieces). The product is distributed by Danone US, LLC.

Danone US, LLC has recalled YoCrunch Lowfat Yogurt with Toppers, specifically Strawberry and Raspberry flavors, in 8-6oz cup two-product packages due to the presence of foreign material (plastic pieces).
Danone US, LLC is recalling YoCrunch Lowfat Yogurt with Toppers (various two-product packages of Vanilla Yogurt with M&Ms or Oreo pieces) due to the presence of foreign material (plastic pieces).

Danone US, LLC is recalling YoCrunch Low Fat Yogurt with Toppers, Vanilla with Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough pieces, due to contamination with foreign material (plastic pieces). The recalled product is a multipack containing 4-4 oz. cups with UPC 46675-01315.

YoCrunch Low Fat Yogurt with Oreo cookie pieces, in 6 oz. single-serve cups and 4-4 oz. multipacks, is being recalled due to the presence of foreign material (plastic). The product is distributed by Danone US, LLC.
Danone US, LLC is recalling YoCrunch Low Fat Yogurt with Toppers, Strawberry with Granola pieces, Single Serve Cup, 6 oz. (170g) due to the presence of foreign material (plastic pieces).
YoCrunch is recalling its Vanilla Lowfat Yogurt with M&Ms due to undeclared wheat.

YoCrunch Lowfat Yogurt with Toppers, Vanilla with milk chocolate M&Ms, packaged in 6 oz single serve cups and 4-4 oz multipacks, has been recalled due to the presence of foreign material (plastic pieces). The product is distributed by Danone US.

Danone US, LLC is recalling YoCrunch Low Fat Yogurt with Toppers, Vanilla with Snickers pieces, in 6 oz. single serve cups and 4-4 oz. multipacks, due to contamination with foreign material (plastic pieces).

Danone US, LLC is recalling YoCrunch Low Fat Yogurt with Toppers, Vanilla with Twix bar pieces, sold in single-serve and multipack containers, due to the presence of foreign material (plastic pieces).
